reason: The hypothesis proposes a novel, specific intervention—an ultrathin silicon interlayer—to solve the known problem of Cr-Zr interdiffusion in Cr-coated Zr-alloy cladding. While the individual concepts of Cr coatings, interdiffusion problems, and Si-based diffusion barriers exist in the literature, no passage combines them for this specific system or proposes a Si interlayer for nuclear fuel cladding. The mechanism of an amorphous or silicide-forming Si barrier at the Cr-Zr interface is not stated in any passage, and the hypothesis integrates knowledge from disparate fields (nuclear cladding and high-temperature diffusion coatings) into a single, testable proposal.
